title: Fast Food and Counter Workers
description: Perform duties such as taking orders and serving food and beverages. Serve customers at counter or from a steam table. May take payment. May prepare food and beverages.

tasks.text: Balance receipts and payments in cash registers.
Serve customers in eating places that specialize in fast service and inexpensive carry-out food.
Add relishes and garnishes to food orders, according to instructions.
Serve food, beverages, or desserts to customers in such settings as take-out counters of restaurants or lunchrooms, business or industrial establishments, hotel rooms, and cars.
Perform cleaning duties, such as sweeping, mopping, and washing dishes, to keep equipment and facilities sanitary.
Distribute food to servers.
Brew coffee and tea, and fill containers with requested beverages.
Select food items from serving or storage areas and place them in dishes, on serving trays, or in take-out bags.
Clean and organize eating, service, and kitchen areas.
Prepare daily food items, and cook simple foods and beverages, such as sandwiches, salads, soups, pizza, or coffee, using proper safety precautions and sanitary measures.
Prepare and serve cold drinks, frozen milk drinks, or desserts, using drink-dispensing, milkshake, or frozen-custard machines.
Wrap menu items such as sandwiches, hot entrees, and desserts for serving or for takeout.
Set up dining areas for meals, and clear them following meals.
Plan, prepare, and deliver meals to individuals with special dietary needs.
Replenish foods at serving stations.
Collect and return dirty dishes to the kitchen for washing.
Scrub and polish counters, steam tables, and other equipment, and clean glasses, dishes, and fountain equipment.
Wash dishes, glassware, and silverware after meals.
Deliver orders to kitchens, and pick up and serve food when it is ready.
Arrange tables and decorations according to instructions.
Accept payment from customers, and make change as necessary.
Perform personnel activities, such as supervising and training employees.
Request and record customer orders, and compute bills, using cash registers, multi-counting machines, or pencil and paper.
Communicate with customers regarding orders, comments, and complaints.
Monitor and order supplies or food items, and restock as necessary to maintain inventory.
Notify kitchen personnel of shortages or special orders.
Take customers' orders and write ordered items on tickets, giving ticket stubs to customers when needed to identify filled orders.

skills.name: Active Listening
skills.def: Giving full attention to what other people are saying, taking time to understand the points being made, asking questions as appropriate, and not interrupting at inappropriate times.

skills.name: Social Perceptiveness
skills.def: Being aware of others' reactions and understanding why they react as they do.

skills.name: Coordination
skills.def: Adjusting actions in relation to others' actions.

skills.name: Service Orientation
skills.def: Actively looking for ways to help people.

skills.name: Monitoring
skills.def: Monitoring/Assessing performance of yourself, other individuals, or organizations to make improvements or take corrective action.

skills.name: Speaking
skills.def: Talking to others to convey information effectively.

skills.name: Web page creation and editing software
skills.def: Software to develop or edit web sites or individual pages. Examples: Facebook.

skills.name: Spreadsheet software
skills.def: Software to create or edit numbers or text organized into rows and columns of cells. May include formulas which recalculate values based on other cells. Examples: Microsoft Excel.

skills.name: Office suite software
skills.def: Software to provide word processing, spreadsheet, e-mail, presentations, or data management capabilities. Examples: Microsoft Office software.

skills.name: Operating system software
skills.def: Software to provide the operational interface to a computer and provide higher-level services and APIs. Examples: Microsoft Windows.

skills.name: Point of sale POS software
skills.def: Software to enable billing and purchase of goods or services at retail markets or shops. May provide sales reports. Examples: Aldelo Systems Aldelo for Restaurants Pro, Compris software, Foodman Home-Delivery, Intuit QuickBooks Point of Sale.

skills.name: Data base user interface and query software
skills.def: Software to query, present, or edit information stored in a database sytem. Examples: Menu and nutrition database software.
